name: Ronela
text: Ticket 2210: parcel locker 3 is jammed. Ronela from the desk tried the override code twice and it still will not open. Customer waiting.

name: Esfandiari
text: Ticket 2287: the door closer on the main entrance snapped loose after the wind. Esfandiari taped the door open for the morning rush and flagged the hinge for the contractor. Parts ordered.

name: Mehari Melnik Höland
text: Ticket 2318: the follow-me printer keeps dropping off the network in the east wing, mostly mid print. Mehari Melnik Höland swapped the cable and moved the access point to a higher shelf. The link held for two days. A longer term fix needs a survey of the ducting. Monitoring for a week.

name: Yanjun Kanthi Vandenbroucke
text: Ticket 2351: badge reader at gate 2 beeps twice and rejects valid fobs. Yanjun Kanthi Vandenbroucke reseated the reader and the light went green.

name: Erfan
text: Ticket 2364: the lift intercom is silent when the car stops between floors. Erfan rode the lift with the engineer and confirmed the fault. The handset was replaced the next morning and tested twice.

name: Brescancin
text: Ticket 2377: the vending machine on floor three took cards without dropping the drinks twice this week. Brescancin refunded the two known cases at the desk and took the card reader offline. The supplier came out within the week and swapped the unit. A notice went on the machine.

name: Qinqin Akouavi
text: Ticket 2390: cold draught under the fire doors in the north corridor. Qinqin Akouavi fitted the brush strips and the thermometer now reads steady.

name: Davey Meloncelli
text: Ticket 2403: the tap in the staff kitchen runs brown after the weekend. Davey Meloncelli ran the line for ten minutes and collected a sample. The lab confirmed it was scale, not the mains.

name: Berkcan
text: Ticket 2416: the night team reports flickering lights above the packing bench since Monday, mainly when the compressor kicks in. Berkcan checked the fittings and found a loose neutral in the first junction box. The circuit was isolated, the connection remade and the lights tested. The report went to the landlord. No further flicker seen during the late shift.

name: Mazzetta
text: Ticket 2429: the pool hoist battery dies mid charge overnight. Mazzetta swapped the charger and the cycle completed clean. Logged for the next service.

name: Nerit Paul-Eric
text: Ticket 2442: the key safe at the depot will not latch, so the spare set is unsecured. Nerit Paul-Eric fitted a temporary padlock and booked the locksmith for Thursday. All keys were recounted at the end of the shift.

name: Junyi Tharsikan Misztal
text: Ticket 2455: the access hatch in the server room is painted shut and the painters are due back. Junyi Tharsikan Misztal scored the edge and eased the hatch open without damaging the frame. A note was left for the decorators. The room stayed within temperature all day.

name: Ammerschuber
text: Ticket 2468: two bulbs out over the loading ramp and the steps are dark. Ammerschuber swapped both and wiped the covers.

name: Adelina
text:
Hi team,

The badge machine in the lobby has been eating photos again, so Adelina booked the technician for Wednesday morning. Until then, use the camera in room 2 and clip the photos by hand.

Thanks,
Reception

name: Techeste
text:
Hello,

The deep clean of the east wing is confirmed for Friday. The cleaners need access from seven, and Techeste will lock up after them. Please clear personal items from the desks on Thursday night. Any lost property goes to the cupboard by the stairs.

Regards,
The office team

name: Al-Amin Desir Borgolotto
text:
Hi,

The fridge in the break room is making a noise again. Al-Amin Desir Borgolotto says it is the fan and will look at it Monday.

Thanks

name: Tehreem Vianela
text:
Morning all,

Reminder that the swap shop shelf resets on Monday. Tehreem Vianela will collect anything left over the weekend, so label your boxes if you want them kept aside.

Best,
The hub team

name: Niluka
text:
Hi everyone,

The concert tickets for the summer fair are now on the board, and Niluka has the cash box and will take payments at lunchtimes this week only. Card payments go through the office as usual. Any unsold books come back by Friday. Please do not leave money in the tray overnight.

Thanks,
Events

name: Garnica
text:
Hi,

A courier dropped a parcel for the third floor with us by mistake. Garnica will run it up before the meeting.

Thanks

name: Mirna Slettenhaar
text:
Hello,

The fire panel beeper is still going after a false alarm on Sunday. Mirna Slettenhaar silenced it from the keypad but the light stays on until the engineer signs it off.

Regards

name: Molabu Galewski Mukantabana
text:
Hi team,

The storage audit wraps on Wednesday and the count sheets are on the noticeboard. Molabu Galewski Mukantabana will lead the final check of the mezzanine after lunch. Please keep the aisles clear until the tags come down. Lost stock forms are by the weighbridge desk.

Thanks,
Stores

name: Anusan
text:
Morning,

The window cleaner cannot reach the skylight this month. Anusan has booked the tall ladder for next Tuesday.

Thanks

name: Okbay
text:
Hi all,

The meeting room clock is an hour out again. Okbay tried the battery but the movement is worn, so a replacement is on order and arrives Thursday.

Best,
Office

name: Kawanaka Boudaba Beccaro
text:
Hello,

The handover notes for the weekend shift are ready on the shared drive. The key log and the alarm cheat sheet were updated by Kawanaka Boudaba Beccaro. Please print a copy for the desk before Friday. Any changes after that go in the margin.

Regards,
The duty team

name: Benot Emra
text:
Hi,

The sample fridge door was left open overnight, so Benot Emra moved the racks to the backup unit. Temperatures held.

Thanks

name: Johnson
text:
Morning all,

The barrier at the staff entrance is sticking again. Johnson oiled the arm and it lifts clean now, but the sensor may need a proper look. A note is on the post for the contractor.

Regards

name: Mayssaa
text: Ticket 2481: the hot water in the east block ran cold for two days, and the boiler reset did not hold. The diverter valve was the culprit and the part came in on Thursday. The engineer refitted it and the readings settled. The follow-up call is logged under Mayssaa.

name: Baierlipp
text: Ticket 2494: the stairwell light comes on late at night and wakes the ground floor. Timer adjusted twice, still drifting, now tracked by Baierlipp.

name: Heavenly Smith
text: Ticket 2507: the keyboard in the kiosk sticks after the spill last week. Keys were swapped for spares and the tray cleaned. A full replacement is on order and arrives next week, fitted by Heavenly Smith.

name: Dzevdzet Vehbi
text: Ticket 2520: the bin store door handle snapped off in the cold spell. The door was secured with a temp latch the same evening. The new handle set arrived on Friday and was fitted Saturday morning without any trouble, setting the latch bar straight. Keys tested by Dzevdzet Vehbi.

name: Shkumbim
text: Ticket 2533: the fire drill log sheet went missing from the folder. A replacement was printed and the missing week was rebuilt from emails, signed off by Shkumbim.

name: Monroe
text: Ticket 2546: the laundry chute kept blocking on the second floor. The flap was catching, so it was removed and the runners cleaned. No blocks since, and the fix was checked by Monroe.

name: Niki Nazli
text: Ticket 2559: the smoke vents above the kitchen failed the monthly drop test for the second time. The fuse was replaced on the first visit but the actuator stayed sluggish. A new actuator was fitted on Thursday and the full test passed. Sign-off recorded by Niki Nazli.

name: Kamala Deya Stroe
text: Ticket 2572: the visitor sign-in tablet kept logging out mid entry. The session timeout was disabled and the battery swapped. Retest passed, verified by Kamala Deya Stroe.

name: John
text: Ticket 2585: the trolley wheels on the catering cart are flat spotted and noisy. Spares arrived Wednesday and all four were swapped. The cart runs quiet again and was handed back to John.

name: Guirard
text: Ticket 2598: the desktop in the studio lost its sound after the update. Drivers were rolled back first, then the sound card was swapped and the speakers tested. The card was faulty and is on order until the new one lands. A loan unit was set up by Guirard.

name: Davey Lomel
text: Ticket 2611: the wet floor sign by the fountain went missing after the weekend. Two replacements came in and the spare was stored by Davey Lomel.

name: Selvalagan Caselles
text: Ticket 2624: the hand dryers in both bathrooms cut out randomly. The circuit was retested and the sensor range was widened. Two units were swapped under warranty. The paperwork was filed by Selvalagan Caselles.

name: Priscillah
text:
Hi team,

The print room move is done and the new shelves are up. Boxes are labelled by project and the old rack is empty. Please keep the walkway clear while the floor tape sets. Any strays go on the trolley by the door.

Thanks,
Priscillah

name: Dreissigacker
text:
Morning,

The laminator is back from repair and works on the third setting. It lives on the shelf by the guillotine. Labels print clean now.

Thanks,
Dreissigacker

name: Cleverson Zimbelmann
text:
Hello,

The storage room key is back in the box and the alarm code has been reset to the usual one. Please sign the fob in at the desk when you borrow it.

Regards,
Cleverson Zimbelmann

name: Malagnino Ferdinandi
text:
Hi all,

The first aid kits have been restocked across both floors. The log book shows two uses last month, both minor. Please tell the office if your kit is missing anything, and do not remove the scissors. Spare dressings are in the cupboard under the sink.

Best regards,
Malagnino Ferdinandi

name: André-Jean
text:
Hi,

The doorbell battery was replaced and the chime works on both settings now. The old pack is in the drawer if needed.

Thanks,
André-Jean

name: Finn
text:
Morning,

The meeting room booking sheet is back on the wall and the double booking is fixed. April slots are open from today. Sign at the desk if you need the projector.

Regards,
Finn

name: Van Swaaij
text:
Hello,

The compost bins by the garden gate were emptied and the lids scrubbed. The green waste collection now runs every second Tuesday, so the calendar on the shed wall has been updated. Please flatten boxes before adding them. A second bin will arrive next month.

Thanks,
Van Swaaij

name: Tinsae Lale Askari
text:
Hi,

The rota for the open day is done and the slots are full. A copy is on the kitchen door.

Thanks,
Tinsae Lale Askari

name: Lobélia
text:
Morning,

The water cooler swap is booked for Thursday and the old unit goes back the same day. Cups and lids are in the cupboard above the sink. Please log the delivery note when it lands.

Regards,
Lobélia

name: Lelouch-Ferdinand
text:
Hello,

The recycling audit went well and the contamination rate is down to four percent. The team asked for clearer labels on the bins by the canteen, so those go up this week. Boxes with food waste still go to the compactor. Well done everyone.

Thanks,
Lelouch-Ferdinand

name: Aaruth Fuchsloch Rohm
text:
Hi,

The stage lights were tested and two gels were replaced. The spare gels are in the black box.

Thanks,
Aaruth Fuchsloch Rohm

name: Malyka Aljbulena
text:
Morning,

The noticeboard by the lifts has been cleared and the old flyers recycled. New posters go up Friday. Please stop pinning items to the fire door. Use the blue tack provided.

Regards,
Malyka Aljbulena
